def collapse_whitespace(s: str) -> str:
    import re
    # Collapse runs of the specified ASCII whitespace characters into a single space
    collapsed = re.sub(r'[ \t\r\n\x0b\x0c]+', ' ', s)

def collapse_whitespace(s):
    """Collapse runs of ASCII whitespace into a single space and strip ends."""
    # Strip leading and trailing ASCII whitespace: space, tab, LF, CR, vertical tab, form feed
    stripped = s.strip(' \t\r\x0b\x0c')
    # Collapse any run of those characters to a single space
    import re
    collapsed = re.sub(r'[ \t\r\x0b\x0c]+', ' ', stripped)
    return collapsed
